exposure: fertility-preserving therapy (in vitro fertilization (IVF), medroxyprogesterone acetate (MPA), intrauterine device (IUD))
cohort: The study included 82 women diagnosed with various forms of endometrial hyperplasia or endometrioid endometrial carcinoma stage IA who underwent IVF at a specific fertility center.
finding: All endometrial hyperplasia and carcinoma groups demonstrated competent cumulative live birth rates following IVF procedures, and while endometrial thickness differed by treatment, this did not significantly impact clinical pregnancy rates.
